punchline: During the Blitz, Churchill went to the bombed streets on his own feet.
thirty_sec: When German bombs began falling on London in September 1940, Winston Churchill, prime minister for a few months, went to the damaged streets after the raids and let people see him there. Erik Larson's The Splendid and the Vile describes him visibly shaken by what he found and watching raids from rooftops. London took months of bombing and kept working.
